data.name: Key West Tour with Dolphin Spotting Boat from Miami
data.headline: Full-day coach trip from Miami to Key West with a dolphin-spotting boat tour and free time to explore the island.
data.description: Travel from Miami to Key West on a scenic, full-day excursion that blends urban highlights with coastal beauty. Enjoy a comfortable coach journey along the Overseas Highway, watch for dolphins on a guided boat tour, and spend leisurely free time wandering Key West’s colorful streets, sampling seafood, and soaking up the island atmosphere. This curated day trip is designed for relaxation and discovery, offering photo-ready views, marine wildlife sightings, and the freedom to explore Key West at your own pace.

highlight_box.title: Miami: Key West Tour with Dolphin Spotting Boat
highlight_box.description: Key West Tour with Dolphin Spotting Boat from Miami. This perfectly curated adventure offers the ultimate island-style relaxation and vibrant exploration!

data.highlights:
* Visit Key West from Miami in one day
* Spot dolphins in their natural habitat during the boat tour
* Soak in the sun on the boat deck
* Enjoy free time to explore Key West
data.itinerary:
1. Ca. 6.30AM bus departure from select Miami meeting points
2. Ca. 11.30AM arrival in Key West depending on traffic
3. Dolphin spotting boat tour
4. Ca. 2 hours free time to explore Key West on your own
5. Ca. 5.30PM bus departure back to Miami
6. Ca. 9.00PM arrival in Miami depending on traffic

meeting_point.address: 700 Collins Avenue Miami Beach, FL US 33139

data.what_is_included:
Boat tour from Key West to spot dolphins
Refreshments on the boat
Free time to explore Key West
what_is_included_items: Boat tour from Key West to spot dolphins

data.cancellation_summary: Cancel for free up to 24 hours before departure
data.check_in_details: Meet at 700 Collins Avenue, Miami Beach, FL 33139. Pick up is provided from any Miami Beach hotel along 7500 to 600 Collins Avenue or at 340 Biscayne Boulevard in Downtown Miami.
data.disclaimers: Timings are approximate and depend on traffic. Arrival and departure times may vary. Dolphin sightings cannot be guaranteed.
